about.description:
abicheck combines binary, debug-info, public-header, build-system, and
optional source evidence to detect C/C++ ABI/API compatibility breaks.
It reports removed symbols, signature and type-layout changes, vtable and
enum drift, linker metadata changes, and other compatibility risks while
identifying which checks were possible with the supplied evidence.

It supports ELF, PE/COFF, and Mach-O binaries; Markdown, JSON, SARIF, HTML,
and JUnit reports; snapshot baselines; policy profiles and suppressions;
Python and command-line APIs; and CI integration through a GitHub Action.
about.summary: Modern Python-native ABI compatibility checker for C/C++ shared libraries

name: abicheck
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "abicheck" %}
{% set version = "0.5.0" %}
{% set python_min = "3.10" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/abicheck/{{ name }}/archive/refs/tags/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5daf5f0779d923359062493bedba7b7ec48448e38abf5243096df4cf1d887ade

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools >=68,<75
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - click >=8.0
    - rich-click >=1.7
    - pyyaml >=6.0
    - defusedxml >=0.7.1
    - pyelftools >=0.29
    - packaging >=21.0
    - pefile >=2023.2.7
    - macholib >=1.16
    - castxml >=0.6.3  # required for header/type analysis mode

test:
  imports:
    - abicheck
  commands:
    - abicheck --help
    - abicheck --version
    - abicheck dump --help
    - abicheck compare --help
    - abicheck scan --help
    - abicheck deps --help
    - abicheck compat --help
    - python -c "import abicheck.cli, abicheck.service, abicheck.reporter"
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/abicheck/abicheck
  summary: Modern Python-native ABI compatibility checker for C/C++ shared libraries
  description: |
    abicheck combines binary, debug-info, public-header, build-system, and
    optional source evidence to detect C/C++ ABI/API compatibility breaks.
    It reports removed symbols, signature and type-layout changes, vtable and
    enum drift, linker metadata changes, and other compatibility risks while
    identifying which checks were possible with the supplied evidence.

    It supports ELF, PE/COFF, and Mach-O binaries; Markdown, JSON, SARIF, HTML,
    and JUnit reports; snapshot baselines; policy profiles and suppressions;
    Python and command-line APIs; and CI integration through a GitHub Action.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  doc_url: https://abicheck.github.io/abicheck/
  dev_url: https://github.com/abicheck/abicheck

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - napetrov
